rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: join:1.1: can: p652-strip800.jpg: 668's header prints MORECAMBE 10.10.10.10., and system 1's row prints line 2's first word, a preposition, with a capital after a comma, though the page prints that word lowercase mid-line in system 3 (p652-strip1600.jpg). Joined, lines 1 and 2 make one 20-syllable line, which the metre forbids, and the capital is left unexplained. moveup:1.1: can: p652-strip800.jpg system 1 row prints line 2's first word with a capital after a comma, which only a line opening explains (the page prints it lowercase mid-line in system 3, p652-strip1600.jpg). Moved up, it would close line 1, and lines 1 and 2 would have 11 and 9 syllables against the header's 10.10.10.10. split:1.2: can: p652-strip800.jpg header prints 10.10.10.10.; line 2 runs from the end of system 1's row there into system 2's row on p652-strip1600.jpg at 10 syllables. Split before its capitalised divine name, it gives lines of 4 and 6 syllables, which the metre forbids. join:1.2: can: p652-strip1600.jpg system 2 row: line 3 opens after a semicolon on a pronoun of God, capitalised anyway, but the header's 10.10.10.10. (p652-strip800.jpg) fixes the lines: joined, lines 2 and 3 make one 20-syllable line in a three-line stanza. join:1.3: can: p652-strip1600.jpg system 3 row: line 4 opens after a comma on the vocative interjection, capitalised anyway, but the header's 10.10.10.10. (p652-strip800.jpg) fixes the lines: joined, lines 3 and 4 make one 20-syllable line before the Amen.
